foreground_descriptions.name: Right Ventricle Cavity
foreground_descriptions.description: Right ventricular cavity: In a mid-ventricular short-axis MRI slice, this blood pool typically forms a crescent along the outer septal border of the left ventricle.
foreground_descriptions.observation: In the inspected training MRI and label pairs, the labelled RV lies outside the LV myocardial ring and next to the septum. Its outline varies from a curved crescent to a broad or elongated cavity. At sampled end slices it can occupy a much smaller labelled region or have no RV label. These patterns vary with slice level and cardiac phase. The spatial relation does not specify a fixed image direction.

foreground_descriptions.name: Myocardium
foreground_descriptions.description: Myocardium: The left ventricular muscle forms a ring around the left ventricular blood pool in mid-ventricular short-axis MRI. Its septal portion separates the two ventricular cavities.
foreground_descriptions.observation: In the inspected training pairs, MYO surrounds the LV blood pool in central short-axis slices, with the septal wall separating it from the RV. Wall thickness and cavity size vary with patient and cardiac phase. Toward the sampled apical end, the muscle can form a small ring or a labelled muscular region with little or no labelled LV cavity. The basal-side sampled contours also differ from the central slices.

foreground_descriptions.observation_zh: 在这些训练患者的中段切面中，MYO围绕LV血池，靠RV的肌性间隔分开两腔。肌壁厚度与腔大小随病例及时相变化；接近所选心尖侧端部时可见小环，或只有MYO标注而LV标签很少、甚至为空的肌性区域。所选心底侧轮廓也可与中段不同。

foreground_descriptions.name: Left Ventricle Cavity
foreground_descriptions.description: Left ventricular cavity: In mid-ventricular short-axis MRI, this blood pool typically appears round within the myocardial ring, across the interventricular septum from the crescent-shaped right ventricular cavity.
foreground_descriptions.observation: In the inspected training pairs, the LV blood pool lies inside the myocardial wall, across the septum from the RV when both cavities are labelled. Its outline is round, oval or irregular. Central cavities are generally larger than the small labelled cavities at the sampled apical end. Some terminal slices have no LV label. Papillary or trabecular structures affect the visible boundary. Cardiac phase and slice level alter cavity size and shape.

foreground_descriptions.observation_zh: 在这些训练患者的所选切面中，LV位于心肌壁内，两腔均有标注时与RV隔间隔相邻；轮廓可近圆、椭圆或不规则。所选心尖侧端部的LV标签通常比中段小，部分终端切面没有LV标签。乳头肌/小梁样结构影响可见边界，层面及时相均会改变腔形与大小。
